title: USA Rare Earth Achieves Major Operational and Strategic Milestone with Commissioning of Phase 1a Magnet Production at Stillwater Facility
notes: PROPOSED, NOT SEEDED. Issuer release announcing commissioning of the Phase 1a commercial magnet production line at Stillwater, Oklahoma. It reports commissioning, not sustained commercial output, and does not attribute the milestone to CHIPS or other public financing. Enters data/seed/sources.json only with an approved M3.3 milestone.
